column1: # 🔴 The structural half, which is why `p423` built an instrument rather than just fixing six
# files: THREE of the five new reds (register-currency, census-currency, union-currency) are
# POST-WRITE gates by construction.  Their own headers say to run them as the last act before
# the commit.  `p412`'s standing rule says to run the suite FIRST, before the research legs.
# Both rules are right and nothing enforced the second, so a pass that obeys p412 perfectly
# still cannot catch what it is itself about to write.
# 🔴 And the enforcement was not available: `make hooks` has exited non-zero since `p398` by
# design, so no commit hook could ever have asked it a yes-or-no question.  A permanently red
# suite is a colour, not a control.  `DECLARED_RED` / `make commit-gates` / `ingest/pre-commit`
# separate the deliberate red from the real ones so the suite can mean yes or no again.
